# OpenDocument example

`reference.odt` is a binary Pandoc reference document for LibreOffice Writer. Define the named
styles you want Pandoc to carry into the exported `.odt` file.

`metadata.yaml` demonstrates the same first-page metadata as the Word example: title, subtitle,
author, date and abstract. In LibreOffice, edit the corresponding paragraph styles in
`reference.odt` rather than styling the example text directly.

The package otherwise matches the Word example: `metadata.yaml` supplies sample note metadata and
`defaults.yaml` contains package-local settings.
